post.description:
Sign in with a local username and password.

Returns your account details and signs this browser in. Provide the sign-in header
shown in the request parameters.

parameters.description: Set this header to login when starting sign-in.
parameters.name: x-csrf-token

200.description: Signed in. Browser sign-in details have been updated.

401.description: The username or password was not accepted.

403.description: This sign-in request could not be verified.

429.description: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait before trying again.

Retry-After.description: How long to wait, in seconds.

503.description: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.

post.summary: Sign in with a local account

post.description:
Sign this browser out of TinyPods.

Other browsers stay signed in. Signing out here does not sign you out of an
external identity provider.

parameters.description: Copy the current CSRF cookie value into this header.
parameters.name: x-csrf-token

200.description: This browser is signed out of TinyPods.

401.description: Sign in before using this action.

403.description: This sign-out request could not be verified.

get.description:
Show the sign-in methods available for this installation.

Use this list to display a local account form or an external sign-in button.

post.description:
Sign out the browsers identified by a verified notification from Zitadel.

This endpoint is called by Zitadel directly and does not require browser cookies.

400.description: The sign-out notification could not be verified.

get.description:
Complete sign-in after returning from Zitadel.

Signs this browser in and sends you to the page chosen when sign-in started.
The sign-in attempt must still be valid.

303.description: Signed in. Continue to the requested page.

post.description:
Sign this browser out of TinyPods and get a link to sign out of Zitadel.

Open the returned link to finish signing out of Zitadel. This can also sign you
out of other applications using Zitadel in the same browser.

parameters.description: Copy the current CSRF cookie value into this header.
parameters.name: x-csrf-token

200.description: Signed out of TinyPods. Open the returned link to sign out of Zitadel.

503.description: Signed out of TinyPods; Zitadel sign-out is unavailable.

post.summary: Sign out of TinyPods and Zitadel

post.description:
Keep this browser signed in without entering your credentials again.

Send the current CSRF header. A successful renewal replaces the browser's
sign-in credentials; expired or reused renewal credentials require a new login.

parameters.description: Copy the current CSRF cookie value into this header.
parameters.name: x-csrf-token

401.description: Sign in again to renew this browser session.

409.description: A renewal is already in progress for this browser.

post.description:
Start signing in with Zitadel.

Open the returned link in the same browser. After signing in, you will return
to the page chosen in this request. Select an identity provider from the available
sign-in methods to go directly to that provider, or omit it to use Zitadel’s login page.

parameters.description: Set this header to login when starting sign-in.
parameters.name: x-csrf-token
